newsitem.title: BULGARIA: No majority for Bulgaria's Stoyanov -projection.
newsitem.headline: No majority for Bulgaria's Stoyanov -projection.

text.p: None of the candidates in Sunday's Bulgarian presidential election managed to win 50 percent of the vote to become outright winner, an unofficial projection based on actual results showed.

The projection, by the independent Bulgarian Association for Fair Elections and Civil Rights (BAFE), gave opposition candidate Petar Stoyanov 43 percent of the vote, against 27 percent for his main rival, Socialist Ivan Marazov.
